inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.constructor.db
inputs.description: A caller-supplied synchronous SQLite database handle used by the adapter for prepared statements and exec calls. Construction only registers the models; the caller opens and owns the handle.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.constructor.models
inputs.description: The declared tables and fields this adapter may address. Each model is validated and registered by table name at construction; its primary key defaults to id, and duplicate model table names throw Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.find.table
inputs.description: The registered model table whose row is looked up by its primary key. A table without a registered model cannot be used.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.find.id
inputs.description: The number or string compared with the model primary key, which defaults to id, to find one row.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.findBy.table
inputs.description: The registered model table whose rows are filtered by the supplied model fields.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.findBy.fields
inputs.description: A map of declared model fields to filter values. Values are converted and bound using each field declaration; nullable null values use IS NULL, and an empty map selects all rows.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.create.table
inputs.description: The registered model table into which the input row is inserted.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.create.input
inputs.description: A map of declared model fields and values for the new row. Values are converted and bound using the model; an empty map requests SQLite DEFAULT VALUES.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update.table
inputs.description: The registered model table containing the row to update.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update.id
inputs.description: The number or string compared with the model primary key, which defaults to id, to choose the row to update.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update.input
inputs.description: A map of declared model fields and replacement values. An own property matching the primary key throws Error; an empty map returns the current row, and an updatedAt field with the timestamp default is refreshed to the current ISO time.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.delete.table
inputs.description: The registered model table from which a row is removed.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.delete.id
inputs.description: The number or string compared with the model primary key, which defaults to id, to choose the row to remove.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.insert.table
inputs.description: The registered model table into which the input row is inserted synchronously. This method can be used from a transaction callback.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.insert.input
inputs.description: A map of declared model fields and values for the new row. Values are converted and bound using the model; an empty map requests SQLite DEFAULT VALUES.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.query.sql
inputs.description: The SQL prepared on the supplied database and executed with all(). Use this for caller-defined read queries that are not expressed by the model-based lookup methods.
examples: SELECT id, name FROM tasks WHERE id = ?

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.query.bindings
inputs.description: Values bound positionally to the query SQL placeholders. SqliteValue supports strings, numbers, bigints, Uint8Array values, and null; omitted bindings use an empty array.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.execute.sql
inputs.description: The SQL prepared on the supplied database and executed with run(), typically for caller-defined writes or commands.
examples: UPDATE tasks SET active = ? WHERE id = ?

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.execute.bindings
inputs.description: Values bound positionally to the execute SQL placeholders. SqliteValue supports strings, numbers, bigints, Uint8Array values, and null; omitted bindings use an empty array.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.transaction.write
inputs.description: A synchronous callback whose writes run inside a SQLite savepoint and whose return value is returned after release. Async functions and any callback result with a then method are rejected so the transaction cannot commit before writes finish.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.db
inputs.description: A caller-supplied synchronous SQLite database handle used by the adapter for prepared statements and exec calls. The factory passes it through and does not open or close it.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.models
inputs.description: The declared tables and fields the adapter may address. Each model is validated and registered by table name during construction; its primary key defaults to id, and duplicate model table names throw Error.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.find
outputs.description: The requested row mapped from the SQLite result, or null when no row matches the supplied primary-key value.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.findBy
outputs.description: The rows matching the supplied declared-field filters, mapped to application properties. An empty filter map returns all rows.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.create
outputs.description: The inserted row returned by the table adapter after SQLite INSERT ... RETURNING * and row mapping.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update
outputs.description: The updated row returned by SQLite and mapped to application properties, or null when no row is returned. An empty input map instead returns the current result of find.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.delete
outputs.description: True when SQLite reports that at least one row was removed; otherwise false.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.insert
outputs.description: The inserted row returned by SQLite INSERT ... RETURNING * and row mapping. This call is synchronous and can run inside transaction.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.query
outputs.description: All rows returned by the prepared statement's all() call, typed as T[] for the caller.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.execute
outputs.type: { changes: number | bigint; lastInsertRowid: number | bigint }
outputs.description: The value returned by the prepared statement's run() call, such as its changes count and last inserted row id.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.createTables
outputs.description: No value. Executes CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for every registered model on the supplied database.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.transaction
outputs.description: The exact value returned by the synchronous callback after the savepoint is released.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.assertModels
outputs.description: No value when every non-internal application table and each declared model column match; otherwise the method throws Error.

outputs.name: createSqliteAdapter
outputs.description: A SqliteAdapter bound to the supplied database and validated model declarations; the factory does not open a database.

errors.name: SQLite model, schema, or transaction failure
errors.description: Model validation, table lookup, field conversion, schema checks and transaction guards can throw Error. Driver and callback failures propagate without translation; a failed rollback can replace the callback failure.
